title: Accident bundle: photograph of the junction, image withheld
summary: The committed-but-unresolvable image state, which must render distinctly from 'no image' and from a resolved one. It is deliberately the exhibit whose absence costs the most: the two witness statements disagree about whether the northbound car entered on amber, and this is the only thing in the bundle that bears on it. A render that lets this look like a photograph nobody took has hidden the hole in the argument. Its subject is also neither a party nor a thing but a PLACE, so it carries no issuee, no VIN and no plate -- a fourth subject kind inside one bundle.
